title: The Best Sourdough Apple Fritters

components.name: Overnight Sponge
directions: To a large bowl add sourdough starter, sugar, flour, milk, and melted butter. Mix all together until everything is a wet combined dough. Cover tightly and ferment overnight 8–12 hours.

components.name: After Ferment
ingredients: 1 quart lard or coconut oil for frying

components.name: Glaze
ingredients: 1/4 cup whole milk or heavy cream
directions: In the morning heat cooking oil to 350°F. This takes time so start this step first.
To the overnight sponge bowl add egg, diced apple, cinnamon, nutmeg, clove, salt, and baking soda. Mix everything together by hand so it becomes more batter-like. It will be sticky and wet.
While oil is heating, make the glaze: mix powdered sugar, milk, and vanilla until smooth. Thin with more milk if desired. Set aside.

Carefully plop 1/4 cup batter into hot oil. Press batter down lightly with a potato masher to flatten into more of a disk, then remove the masher. Cook each side for 2 minutes until a crispy deep golden brown. Remove with a slotted spoon onto paper towels to drain. Allow the oil to heat back up between fritters.
Dip or drizzle fritters into glaze. Serve immediately.

notes: Don't waste the remaining oil — strain and save it for next time.
